{{Top|leg}}
'''Judicial Inspectors''' were [[Inspector/Legends|inspectors]] with far reaching powers that worked for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]]. They were charged with ensuring that the [[Planetary Security Forces]] kept the sizes of their fleets and [[Starship/Legends|starships]] within Judicial regulations.
